# Drydock

> Rescues files from a failing Yandex.Disk: inventories the collection,
> probes availability without downloading, downloads what is still served,
> verifies hashes, packs into 7z volumes, deletes from the cloud only what is
> verified or explicitly selected. Windows, macOS and Linux, Python 3.12+.

- [README](https://github.com/venedicus/drydock#readme): what it does, quick start
- [How it works](https://github.com/venedicus/drydock/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): inventory, probe, download, verification, loop, archive, delete
- [Limitations](https://github.com/venedicus/drydock/blob/main/docs/limitations.md): what it does not do and why
- [Comparison](https://github.com/venedicus/drydock/blob/main/docs/comparison.md): Drydock vs a sync client vs rclone
- [Security](https://github.com/venedicus/drydock/blob/main/SECURITY.md): token storage, what to report
- [Contributing](https://github.com/venedicus/drydock/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests, translation rules
- [Changelog](https://github.com/venedicus/drydock/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
